external_actions_resolution_whole.name: external_actions_resolution_whole
external_actions_resolution_whole.value: ("integrations"."external_actions"."resolution" is null) = ("integrations"."external_actions"."resolved_by_membership_id" is null) and ("integrations"."external_actions"."resolution" is null) = ("integrations"."external_actions"."resolution_reason" is null)

agent_runs_limits_check.name: agent_runs_limits_check
agent_runs_limits_check.value: "ai"."agent_runs"."max_model_turns" >= 1 AND "ai"."agent_runs"."max_tool_calls" >= 0 AND "ai"."agent_runs"."max_total_tokens" >= 1 AND "ai"."agent_runs"."max_cost_micros" >= 0 AND "ai"."agent_runs"."timeout_seconds" >= 1 AND "ai"."agent_runs"."max_delegation_depth" >= 0 AND "ai"."agent_runs"."depth" >= 0

kill_switches_tenant_check.name: kill_switches_tenant_check
kill_switches_tenant_check.value: ("governance"."kill_switches"."scope" IN ('global','provider') AND "governance"."kill_switches"."organization_id" IS NULL) OR ("governance"."kill_switches"."scope" IN ('organization','agent_version') AND "governance"."kill_switches"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL)

knowledge_model_calls_shape.name: knowledge_model_calls_shape
knowledge_model_calls_shape.value: "knowledge"."model_calls"."decision" = 'deny' or ("knowledge"."model_calls"."model_profile_ref" is not null and "knowledge"."model_calls"."destination_host" is not null)

knowledge_purge_transcript_proof.name: knowledge_purge_transcript_proof
knowledge_purge_transcript_proof.value: "knowledge"."purge_jobs"."transcripts_removed">=0 and (("knowledge"."purge_jobs"."transcripts_checked_at" is null and "knowledge"."purge_jobs"."transcript_source_version" is null and "knowledge"."purge_jobs"."transcript_runs_sha256" is null) or ("knowledge"."purge_jobs"."transcripts_checked_at" is not null and "knowledge"."purge_jobs"."transcript_source_version">0 and "knowledge"."purge_jobs"."transcript_runs_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'))

knowledge_source_grants_shape.name: knowledge_source_grants_shape
knowledge_source_grants_shape.value: ("knowledge"."source_grants"."principal_kind" = 'membership') = ("knowledge"."source_grants"."membership_id" is not null) and ("knowledge"."source_grants"."principal_kind" = 'team') = ("knowledge"."source_grants"."team_id" is not null)

knowledge_sources_shape.name: knowledge_sources_shape
knowledge_sources_shape.value: ("knowledge"."sources"."kind" = 'connector') = ("knowledge"."sources"."connection_id" is not null) and ("knowledge"."sources"."kind" = 'connector') = ("knowledge"."sources"."external_resource_id" is not null)

mcp_tools_approved_shape.name: mcp_tools_approved_shape
mcp_tools_approved_shape.value: "integrations"."mcp_tools"."status" <> 'approved' or ("integrations"."mcp_tools"."side_effect_level" is not null and "integrations"."mcp_tools"."reviewed_by_membership_id" is not null and "integrations"."mcp_tools"."reviewed_at" is not null)

artifact_lineage_inventory_check.name: artifact_lineage_inventory_check
artifact_lineage_inventory_check.value: not "knowledge"."artifact_lineage"."inventory_complete" or ("knowledge"."artifact_lineage"."inventory_sha256" is not null and "knowledge"."artifact_lineage"."inventory_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "knowledge"."artifact_lineage"."execution_id" is not null and "knowledge"."artifact_lineage"."work_unit_id" is not null)
